Driver: `scripts/lib/browser-slot.sh scripts/lib/stack.sh run -- node .verify/qa/16/qa.mjs` (+ `probe.mjs` for TOC/overflow). Raw output: `.verify/qa/16/results.json`, `structure.json`, `themes.json`. Gate: `VERIFY_ITEMS=16 E2E_FILES=16-callouts scripts/verify.sh --only unit,e2e` → unit 397/397, e2e/16-callouts 9/9, OVERALL PASS. Did not read src/ or the diff.

## Edge cases (all OK unless noted)
`>[!NOTE]`, trailing spaces, `>   [!TIP]` leading spaces (custom title), CRLF (callout + badge), first line of doc (0–2), after frontmatter (3–5), marker-only box, inside list item / `<details>`, mermaid inside callout (renders), nested `> > [!TIP]` (inner is callout), blank-line-separated → 2 boxes, no blank line → 1 box with `[!CAUTION]` literal in body, `\]` in label → "a ] b", 80 chars badge / 81 literal, adjacent badges, badge at line start, badge inside link text, badge inside callout title, live theme toggle (no errors, restyles), print emulation (1px solid border, `break-inside: avoid`, title shown; `print.pdf`). MCP tool descriptions mention both syntaxes. `para\n> [!NOTE] x` renders as a callout — correct CommonMark (a blockquote interrupts a paragraph), noted only.

## Defects
1. **minor** — Long badge labels force horizontal page scroll on phone. A valid 78-char label with spaces (`:rag-red[Blocked on vendor contract signature and legal review, expected next week ok]`) at 390px → `scrollWidth` 581 vs 390; an 80-char single word → 684. Cause is the spec-mandated `nowrap` with no `max-width`/ellipsis. Repro: `.verify/qa/16/probe.mjs` (spaced/long docs); `probe-long-phone.png`, `probe-spaced-phone.png`. Suggest `max-width:100%; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis` on the pill (spec tweak).
2. **cosmetic** — In Default light/dark and Locus themes a `**bold**` word in a custom title is drawn in body text colour, not the type colour ("loss" in "Data loss risk" is black/white); GitHub themes tint it. `theme-light.png`, `theme-locus-dark.png`.
3. **cosmetic** — locus-light Warning (amber) and Caution read as two oranges (Caution icon and border are orange-red rather than red); titles do differ (AC-16.8 colour check passes). `theme-locus-light.png`.
